en.name: Frozen pancakes and waffles
en.summary: Frozen pancakes and waffles keep 3 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Keep them frozen and heat as directed. Refrigerating them after cooking is not recommended, because they go leathery.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage. These are moist, low-acid cooked batters, and a stack thawing on the counter is both a food-safety problem and a texture one — the surface goes damp and then the toaster only steams it. Take out the number you will eat and reseal the bag immediately; the two-hour rule applies to anything left out, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Refrigerating cooked pancakes or waffles is not recommended, and no refrigerated timeline is given. The reason is quality: starch retrogradation runs fastest just above freezing, so a chilled pancake goes leathery and dry within a day, and a waffle loses its crispness entirely. What the fridge does buy is time against mould, which is a real consideration in a hot humid kitchen — but the freezer beats it on both counts, because it stops mould without the staling. Toasting does reverse staling, by re-gelatinising the starch, and does nothing at all for mould.
en.freezer: 3 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. That is a quality window rather than a safety limit — kept continuously at −18 °C they stay safe indefinitely. What runs out is texture: dry edges, ice crystals and freezer burn. Keep them flat in the bag with the air pressed out, interleave homemade ones with baking paper so they peel apart, and freeze them the day they are made rather than after a night in the fridge.
en.thawing: Do not thaw — toast, grill or oven-heat straight from frozen, which is what they are designed for and gives the best texture. Anything that has thawed on the counter should not be refrozen; something thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be, with some quality loss.
spoilage: Dry white patches and curled, brittle edges — freezer burn.
A block of pancakes welded together, meaning the bag part-thawed and refroze.
A stale or freezer smell that survives toasting.
Mould, which only appears on ones that have thawed and been left out.
tips: Toast straight from frozen; do not thaw first.
Interleave homemade ones with paper before freezing.
Press the air out of the bag every time — air causes freezer burn.
Freeze on the day they are cooked, not after a night in the fridge.

faq.q: How long do frozen waffles last?
faq.a: 3 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously frozen they stay safe beyond that, but they dry and freezer-burn.
It is not recommended — they go leathery fast, because chilling speeds up staling. Freeze them instead.

faq.q: Do you need to thaw frozen pancakes?
faq.a: No. Toast or oven-heat them straight from frozen; thawing first leaves them damp and they only steam.

zh.name: 冷凍鬆餅與煎餅
zh.summary: 冷凍鬆餅與煎餅在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可保有最佳品質 3 個月。請保持冷凍並依指示加熱。煮好之後不建議改放冷藏，因為它會變得像皮革。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存這一項。它們是含水量高、低酸的熟麵糊，一疊在檯面上退冰既是食安問題也是口感問題——表面會變潮，之後烤麵包機只是在蒸它。要吃幾片就拿幾片，拿完立刻把袋子封回去；任何擺在外面的都適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 煮好的鬆餅或煎餅不建議改放冷藏，這裡也不給冷藏期限。理由是品質：澱粉回凝在略高於冰點時最快，所以冰過的煎餅一天內就變得又乾又韌，鬆餅則完全失去酥脆。冷藏買到的是對抗霉的時間，這在又熱又濕的廚房裡確實要考慮——但冷凍在兩方面都贏，因為它擋得住霉又不會讓它老化。烤過可以逆轉老化（熱讓澱粉重新糊化），但對霉毫無作用。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 3 個月品質最好。那是品質期限，不是安全上限——全程維持在 −18 °C 就一直是安全的。先用完的是口感：邊緣變乾、長冰晶、凍燒。請平放、壓出袋子裡的空氣；自己做的每片之間夾烘焙紙才撕得開，而且要在做好當天就冷凍，不要先在冷藏放一晚。
zh.thawing: 不要解凍——直接從冷凍進烤麵包機、烤箱或烤盤，它本來就是這樣設計的，口感也最好。在檯面上退冰過的不要再冷凍；在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的可以，只是品質打折。
spoilage: 出現乾白斑塊、邊緣捲起變脆——那是凍燒。
整袋黏成一塊，表示曾經半退冰又再凍。
烤過之後還是聞得到走味或冷凍櫃的味道。
長霉——那只會出現在退冰後又擺在外面的那些。
tips: 直接從冷凍烤，不要先解凍。
自己做的冷凍前每片夾一張紙。
每次都把袋子裡的空氣壓掉——凍燒就是空氣造成的。
做好當天就冷凍，不要在冷藏放過一夜才凍。

faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 3 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰放更久仍然安全，但會變乾、凍燒。

faq.q: 煎好的鬆餅可以冰冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 不建議——冷藏會加速老化，很快就變得像皮革。請改用冷凍。
不用。直接從冷凍烤；先退冰只會讓它變潮，然後被蒸軟。
